During the period of the remand the accused in
this case has been subjected to lengthy questioning
and the following ascertained:-

In October 1937 as a result of hostilities his
parents and the whole family left their native country
Zangchow and proceeded to Chungking where they took up
residence the accused then took up training for a
military career which training was concluded in
December 1938.

In January 1939 he returned to Zangchow where he
obtained employment as a farmers' assistant.

In December 1939 an old acquaintance of his one
named Yeu Kung Doo (俞根土) returned to Zangchow and
they renewed their friendship, and Yeu knowing that
accused had received military training told him that he
Yeu was a member of an assassination group operating
on behalf of the Chungking government, the accused
asked Yeu to have him enrolled as a member but despite
his persistant efforts was refused being told that he
was much too young to carry out the hazardous assign-
ments which the group had to fulfill. Accused pressed
his point by stating that he was not afraid to die
carrying out work on behalf of the Government but Yeu
still refused to enroll him.

Early in April 1940 Yeu informed accused that he

在该案被告还押候审期间，对其进行了长时间讯问，查明情况如下：-

1937年10月，因战事影响，其父母及全家离开家乡常州，前往重庆定居。被告随后接受军事职业训练，该训练于1938年12月结束。

1939年1月，他返回常州，受雇担任农民助手。

1939年12月，他的一位名叫俞根土（Yeu Kung Doo）的老相识回到常州，两人重修旧好。俞某得知被告受过军事训练后，告知被告他是代表重庆政府行动的一个暗杀小组成员。被告请求俞某将其吸纳为成员，但尽管被告坚持努力，仍遭拒绝，被告知他太年轻，无法执行该小组必须完成的危险任务。被告坚称自己不怕死，愿意为政府执行工作，但俞某仍拒绝接纳他。

1940年4月初，俞某告知被告，他

（印：已索引 / (特别分部) 登记处 / 日期 1940年5月15日 / [签名]）

was leaving Zengchow for Shanghai to fulfill an assign-
ment and later stated that his work was that of
assassination, the accused asked to be allowed to go with
him, but was refused, however after repeating that he
was not afraid You agreed to let him accompany him.
    They travelled to Shanghai together by train and
alighted at the North Station after which they crossed to
the South of the Soochow Creek, the passes which they had
used to travel with being destroyed by them, once South
of the Creek, You took accused to the Chekiang Lodging
643 Chekiang Rd.
House, where he booked room No.73 for accused and left
him saying that he would call for him the following
morning, at about 8 a.m. the next morning You called for
accused and told him that he wished him to reside in
another lodging house, to which he took accused and
opened a room for him, accused does not know the name
or address of this lodging house. After being installed
at this lodging house You took him through the streets
explaining the names etc. to him this procedure was
followed daily, but no mention of the work which they had
come to do was made.
    One afternoon a few days after they had arrived in
Shanghai You and the accused were walking in the vicinity
of Avenue Road, when they encountered a male Chinese who
appeared to be a friend of You's, these two persons
conversed and walked together, accused following in
pages.zh:
1098/40.

将离开常州前往上海执行任务，后来又说他的工作是暗杀。被告请求允许同行，但遭拒绝。然而，在被告再次表示不怕死后，俞某同意让他陪同。
    两人乘火车一同前往上海，在北站下车，随后穿过苏州河以南。他们用于旅行的通行证已被销毁。过河后，俞某将被告带至浙江路643号的浙江旅馆，为被告预订了73号房间，然后离开，称次日早晨会来叫他。第二天早上约8点，俞某来叫被告，告诉他希望他住到另一家旅馆去，随即将被告带到那里并为他开了一个房间。被告不知道这家旅馆的名称或地址。入住该旅馆后，俞某带他穿街走巷，向他解释街道名称等。这一程序每天都进行，但未提及他们来此要做的工作。
    抵达上海几天后的一个下午，俞某和被告在爱文义路附近行走时，遇到一名看似是俞某朋友的中国男子。这两人交谈并一同行走，被告跟在后面

pages.en:
1098/40.
3/3.                                                                 1.

the rear, suddenly accused saw a male Chinese approach
You and his friend from the side of the road on which
they were walking and accused saw that he had a pistol
in his hand seeing the pistol accused started to run
back the way they had come, and whilst running heard a
shot, he then looked back and saw You running across
the road so he turned and followed him, when he caught
up with You he noticed that he appeared to be very afraid
and they continued on away from the place where the shot
had been fired, and instead returning to accused lodging
house You took him to another name and address unknown to
accused, where You opened another room for him, after
which he left saying he would return the following day,
as arranged You called at accused's room the following
day and opened a conversation about the shooting on the
previous day, the accused appeared to be very upset, and
stated that it was probably a mistake and he thought that
he should have been the victim, this murder forms the
subject of Sinzu F.I.R. No.1293/40.

    A few days after the shooting You told accused that
the person responsible for the shooting was a traitor
and asked accused if he could recognise this man, accused
said that he could and gave You a brief description of
the man he had seen, You then told accused that he had
described the man and added that he was a part time
pages.zh:
1098/40.
3/3.                                                                 1.

被告突然指控称，看见一名中国男子从他们行走的道路一侧走近尤（You）及其朋友，并且看见该男子手中持有一把手枪。看到手枪后，被告开始沿原路往回跑，在奔跑过程中听到一声枪响，他随即回头看见尤正在横穿马路，于是转身跟随尤。当被告追上尤时，注意到尤显得非常恐惧，他们继续远离枪击发生地。尤没有带被告返回其寄宿处，而是将他带到另一个被告不知姓名和地址的地方，并在那里为被告另开了一间房。随后尤离开，称次日会回来。按照约定，被告次日来到尤的房间，就前一天的枪击事件展开交谈。尤显得非常不安，并称这可能是一个误会，他认为自己本应是受害者。这起谋杀案是辛扎（Sinzu）第一调查报告（F.I.R.）第1293/40号的主题。

    枪击发生几天后，尤告诉被告，负责枪击的人是一名汉奸，并问被告是否能认出此人。被告称可以，并简要描述了其所见之人的特征。尤随后告诉被告，他所描述的就是那个人，并补充说此人是位于戈登路（Gordon Road）附近静安寺路（B'Well Road）的大华大学（Great China University）的兼职学生。

pages.en:
1098/40.
3/4.                                                                 1.

student at the Great China University on B'Well Road
near Gordon Road. Accused was then asked by You if he
would assassinate this man and accused stated that if
the man was a traitor he was not afraid to kill him,
after accused agreed to do the assassination You took him
to B'Well Road and pointed the university out to him, he
then told accused to visit the university daily between
12 noon and 1 p.m. to spot the traitor and ascertain
on what days he attended and the time of his arrival.
    Accused kept observation for two weeks and had
seen the man attend on 2 occasions both times being
Monday afternoons and he had arrived at about 1 p.m.
accused reported the result of his observations to You
who after receiving the report stated that May 1st was
labour day and that the man must attend the school on
that day in the afternoon, and suggested that accused

Sung Yih Bing (陳一平)
Zangchow                                      D.S.I. Burton
Chengtu Rd Stn.      7th. May 1940            D.S.I. Yao Yuen Loong

In October 1937 I together with my family left Zangchow
where we had always resided and proceeded to Chungking. On
taking up residence in Chungking I commenced a military career
which was concluded in December 1938. In January 1939 I
returned to Zangchow where I obtained employment assisting in
farm work.
    In December 1939 a friend of mine also a native of
Zangchow named Yue Kung Doo returned to Zangchow and we
renewed our acquaintance. He knowing that I had received
military training told me that he was a member of an assassina
tion group operating on behalf of the Chungking Government,
I requested Yue Kung Doo to enroll me as a member of this
group, he replied that I was too young, and that the work was
far too dangerous for me to carry out, I repeatedly asked to
be enrolled, pressing my point by stating that I was not afraid
to take on the mission to which I would be assigned and that I
was not afraid to die carrying out work on behalf of the
Chungking Government.
    Early in April this year Yue Kung Doo informed me that he
was leaving for Shanghai to carry out some work but he did not
mention the nature of this work, I asked that he allow me to
accompanying him, he then replied that the work which he was
to carry out in Shanghai was an assassination and would be
very dangerous, and refused to allow me to accompany him,
however I persisted and told him I was not afraid and he
finally consented to my accompanying him.
    We travelled to Shanghai by train and got off at the
pages.zh:
宋一平（Sung Yih Bing，原文注：陳一平）
沧州                                      D.S.I. 伯顿（Burton）
成都路站      1940年5月7日            D.S.I. 姚元龙（Yao Yuen Loong）

1937年10月，我与家人离开了我们一直居住的沧州，前往重庆。在重庆定居后，我开始了军旅生涯，并于1938年12月结束。1939年1月，我回到沧州，受雇协助从事农活。
    1939年12月，我的一位同为沧州人的朋友岳公度（Yue Kung Doo，音译）回到沧州，我们恢复了交往。他知道我受过军事训练，便告诉我他是代表重庆政府运作的一个刺杀团体的成员。我请求岳公度吸收我加入该团体，他回答说我太年轻，这项工作对我而言过于危险，我无法承担。我反复要求加入，强调我不害怕接受指派给我的任务，也不害怕为重庆政府执行工作而牺牲。
    今年4月初，岳公度通知我，他将前往上海执行某些工作，但未提及工作性质。我请求他允许我随行，他随后回答说，他在上海要执行的工作是一次刺杀，非常危险，并拒绝让我随行。然而，我坚持己见，告诉他不害怕，他最终同意我随行。
    我们乘火车前往上海，在

pages.en:
-Sheet 2-

North Station, the passes which we used to travel with we
destroyed after leaving the Station.
On arriving South of the Soochow Creek we proceeded to
the Chekiang Lodging House where Yue Kung Doo booked a room
for me (No.73), after which he left the lodging house, inform-
ing me that he would call for me the following morning. At
about 8 a.m. the next morning Yue Kung Doo called for me and
told me that he wished me to reside in another lodging house,
to which he escorted me (I do not know the name of the lodging
house or where it is situated). At this lodging house he also
booked a room for me (I do not know the number). All expenses
were paid by him and at odd times he gave me sums of money
ranging from $3.00 to $5.00. Daily Yue Kung Doo called for
me and took me walking on various roads explaining the names,
etc., to me, so far no mention of the work we were to carry
out had been made.
One afternoon, about 3 weeks ago, Yue Kung Doo and I were
walking in the vicinity of Avenue Road, when Yue Kung Doo
encountered a male Chinese whom he appeared to knew, they
started to walk together conversing, I following in the rear,
suddenly I saw a male Chinese with a pistol in his hand
approach Yue Kung Doo and his friend from the side of the road
on which we were walking, I being in the rear started to run
back. I then heard a shot and saw Yue Kung Doo decamping across
the road, so I followed him, he appeared to be very afraid and
instead of returning to the lodging house, where I was staying
he took me to another, where he opened a room for me, after
pages.zh:
-第2页-

北站下车。离开车站后，我们将用于旅行的通行证销毁。
到达苏州河以南后，我们前往浙江旅馆，岳公度为我预订了一个房间（73号），随后他离开旅馆，告知我次日早晨会来叫我。第二天早上约8点，岳公度来叫我，告诉我希望我住在另一家旅馆，并护送我前往（我不知道那家旅馆的名称或位置）。在那家旅馆，他也为我预订了一个房间（我不知道房间号）。所有费用均由他支付，并不时给我3.00元至5.00元不等的钱款。岳公度每天来叫我，带我到各条马路上散步，向我解释路名等，至此尚未提及我们要执行的工作。
大约三周前的一个下午，岳公度和我在霞飞路附近散步时，岳公度遇到了一名看似认识的中国男子，他们开始边走边谈，我跟在后面。突然，我看见一名手持手枪的中国男子从我们行走的道路一侧走近岳公度及其朋友。我在后面，开始往回跑。随后我听到一声枪响，看见岳公度横穿马路逃离，于是我跟随他。他显得非常恐惧，没有带我回我住的旅馆，而是带我去了另一家旅馆，并在那里为我开了一间房，之后

pages.en:
-Sheet 3-

which he left me saying he would call for me the following
day. The next day he again called at the lodging house (name
and address being unknown to me), he was very upset and opened
a conversation about the shooting the previous day saying it
was probably a mistake and that he thought that he was the
one that should have been the victim.
The previous procedure was again adopted Yue Kung Doo
calling for me each morning and walking me through the street
About 3 or 4 days after the shooting Yue Kung Doo told
me that the man responsible for the murder was a traitor and
asked me if I could recognise him. I replied yes, and gave
him a brief description of the man that his hair was cut
short, thick eyebrows and square dark face, wearing foreign
style clothes. Yue Kung Doo then said that was the man and
told me that he was student in the Great China University on
Bubbling Well Road near Gordon Road and asked me if I had
the courage to assassinate this man, I replied if this man is
a traitor why should I be afraid. On my agreeing to his
suggestion Yue Kung Doo took me to Great China University
and pointed out the place to me. He then told me to visit
the university daily between 12 noon and 1 p.m. to verify
on what days he attended the school and the time of his
arrival. After keeping observation for two weeks I had
observed this man on 2 occasions attend the school about 1 p.
each time and each time I had seen him were Mondays. I
reported this to Yue Kung Doo. After receiving the report of
my observation Yue Kung Doo stated that on May the 1st this
pages.zh:
-第3页-

他离开我，说第二天会来叫我。第二天，他又来到那家旅馆（名称和地址我均不知），他非常不安，并就前一天的枪击事件展开交谈，称这可能是一个误会，他认为自己本应是受害者。
随后的程序再次采用，岳公度每天早上来叫我，陪我走在街上。枪击发生约3或4天后，岳公度告诉我，负责谋杀的人是一名汉奸，并问我是否能认出他。我回答说是，并简要描述了那人的特征：短发、浓眉、方形黑脸，穿着西式服装。岳公度随后说就是那个人，并告诉我他是位于戈登路附近静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的大华大学的学生，问我有无勇气刺杀此人。我回答说，如果此人是汉奸，我何必害怕。在我同意他的建议后，岳公度带我到大华大学，并向他指出地点。随后，他指示我每天中午12点至下午1点之间去大学，以核实他在哪些天到校以及到达的时间。经过两周的观察，我曾两次观察到该男子约在下午1点到校，每次都是周一。我将此情况报告给岳公度。收到我的观察报告后，岳公度称，5月1日这天

pages.en:
-Sheet 4-

man must attend the school in the afternoon, he then suggested
that I should assassinate this man on Labour Day and asked me
how I would carry out the assignment, I told him that if he
arrived it would be very easy to shoot him. Yue Fung Doo then
said that I was new in Shanghai and did not know roads it
would be very hard to carry out the work. I replied that he
need not fear that I could do the job, he then gave me
instructions, that after the shooting, I was not to try and
escape, if Police were after me and if they challenged me to
stop I was to do so or they may shoot me dead and that if I
was arrested I was not to divulge any information regarding
the Chungking Government Assassination Groups in Shanghai, I
told him I did not know anything about the groups in Shanghai
or anywhere else, so could not divulge information. He then
told me that I could do the assassination, after giving me
these instructions he left me saying that I was to meet him on
Yu Ya Ching Road near Avenue Road at about 10 a.m. on the
1-5-40. According to arrangements I met him at the appointed
place from where he took me to an alleyway and handed me a
revolver, saying that if you are stopped by Police you must
surrender, however, if you manage to carry out the assassinat-
ion and escape I was to return to the alleyway at 3 p.m. when
he would be waiting to receive the revolver. I put the
revolver inside my long gown in my trousers belt and left him
and proceeded to the university and stood against the bamboo
fence of the university, near a bus stop, after waiting for
some time I saw the man alight from a bus and enter the school
pages.zh:
-第4页-

那人下午必须去学校，于是他建议我在劳动节刺杀此人，并问我如何执行这项任务。我告诉他，如果他到了，开枪打他是很容易的。岳丰度（Yue Fung Doo，音译）随后说，我是新来上海的，不熟悉道路，很难执行这项工作。我回答说，他不必担心，我能完成这项任务。于是他给我指示，说在枪击之后，我不要试图逃跑，如果警察追捕我并喝令我站住，我就必须照做，否则他们可能会将我当场击毙；并且如果我被捕，不得泄露任何关于重庆政府在上海的暗杀团体的信息。我告诉他，我对上海或其他地方的这些团体一无所知，因此无法泄露信息。随后他告诉我，我可以进行刺杀。在给出这些指示后，他离开了我，说我应于1940年5月1日上午10点左右在霞飞路附近的亚尔培路（Yu Ya Ching Road，即今永嘉路）与他见面。按照安排，我在指定地点与他见面，随后他带我到一条弄堂里，递给我一把左轮手枪，说如果你被警察拦住，你必须投降；但是，如果你成功实施刺杀并逃脱，我应于下午3点回到这条弄堂，他会在那里等着收回手枪。我把左轮手枪放在长衫内的裤腰带里，离开他前往大学，站在大学竹篱笆旁，靠近一个公交车站。等了一会儿后，我看见那个人从公交车上下来，进入校园

pages.en:
-Sheet 5-

compound. I followed him, he entered the school premises I
just behind him and as he was mounting the stairs to the 1st
floor I drew my revolver and fired 2 rounds into his back. I
then decamped but on gaining the compound I heard the man whom
I shot raising an alarm, so I returned into the school premises
and fired one more round into his back through the banisters
from the 1st flight of stairs, after I had shot him for the
3rd time he made no more noise and I decamped at the same time
some school students raised an alarm by calling "robber". I
ran onto Bubbling Well Road towards another side road, when I
was challenged by 2 Policemen who called upon me to stop which
I did and they arrested me. I still had my revolver in my
hand. I was then taken to a Police Station.
    This is the only assassination I have committed.
    I do not know where Yue Kung Doo resides and I have
never known his address, his description is:
    Age 26, native of Changchow, height 5'7", round face,
long hair, stout build, wearing blue cloth long gown.
    This is my true statement.
                        Signed and cross marked.
pages.zh:
-第5页-

区域。我跟着他，在他进入校舍后紧随其后，当他正走上通往一楼的楼梯时，我拔出左轮手枪，朝他的背部开了两枪。随后我逃跑了，但刚跑到校园里，就听到被我射击的那个人发出警报声，于是我返回校舍，从第一段楼梯的栏杆间朝他的背部又开了一枪。在我第三次射击后，他不再出声，我随即逃离。与此同时，一些学生高喊“强盗”发出警报。我跑向静安寺路（Bubbling Well Road）的另一条支路，途中被两名警察喝令站住，我照做了，随后他们逮捕了我。当时我手中仍握着左轮手枪。随后我被带到警察局。
    这是我实施的唯一一起刺杀案。
    我不知道岳公度（Yue Kung Doo，音译）住在哪里，我也从未知道过他的地址，他的体貌特征如下：
    年龄26岁，常州人，身高5英尺7英寸，圆脸，长发，体格粗壮，身穿蓝色布长衫。
    这是我的真实供词。

一名名为温斯典（Wen S Dien，音译）的大夏大学男学生，在静安寺路1051号的上述大学内，当正上楼前往一楼时，被上述被告向其背部连开三枪刺杀。

pages.en:
At 1 p.m. 1/5/40 a telephone message was received from C.P.C.285 reporting shooting on B'Well Road near Gordon Road.

The station alarm was rung and all available men under the officer i/c turned out and attended.

On arrival at B'Well and Gordon Roads it was learned that the shooting had taken place in the Great China University (大夏大学), No.1051 Bubbling Well Road, the Police party at once proceeded to the university which is situated on the south side of B'Well Road opposite Gordon Road, and lies back off B'Well Road, being approached through a compound, on entering the school premises it was ascertained that a male student of the university had been shot whilst proceeding upstairs to the first floor, the shot student was lying on his back on the second flight of stairs leading to the 1st floor half way up his head pointing to the 1st floor and his feet towards the first flight landing and an examination of his body showed that he had been shot through the back, it was obvious from a brief examination that the student was dead in the meantime, the S.P.B. Ambulance had been called and removed the student to the Paulun Hospital where he was examined and two Dr.'s certificates were issued reading:- "Brought in dead. Gun shot wounds of chest" the Hospital Doctor also removed a bullet from the dead man's chest, this was handed to police and is a lead .38 revolver bullet and it will be forwarded to the A.I.S. for examination.

Enquiries by D.C.I. Burton, D.S.I. Yao Yuen

1940年5月1日下午1点，接到中央捕房（C.P.C.）285号的电话报告，称戈登路附近的静安寺路上发生枪击事件。

警局警报响起，所有可用警力在负责警官的带领下出动并赶赴现场。

抵达静安寺路与戈登路路口后，获悉枪击发生在静安寺路1051号的大夏大学（Great China University），警方小队立即前往该大学。该校位于静安寺路南侧，戈登路对面，退离静安寺路，需穿过一片空地进入。进入校舍后，查明一名该校男学生在上楼前往一楼的过程中遭枪击。中枪学生仰卧在通往一楼的第二段楼梯中间，头部朝向一楼，脚部朝向第一段楼梯平台。对其身体的检查显示其背部中弹。经简要检查，显然该学生已经死亡。在此期间，工部局警务处救护车已被召来，将该学生送往宝隆医院（Paulun Hospital），经检查后，两名医生出具证明，内容为：“送医时已死亡。胸部枪伤。”医院医生还从死者胸部取出一颗子弹，该子弹已移交警方，为一颗.38口径铅制左轮手枪子弹，将送交助理督察长（A.I.S.）进行检验。

be found.

Whilst enquiries were in progress at the school it was

a revolver seized.

1940年5月1日下午1点左右，死者进入学校准备学习，他每周仅间歇性上课，有时每周下午上课两到三次。当他正走上通往一楼的楼梯时，被一名中国男子从背后开枪射击，向其背部连开三枪，全部命中。对附近进行了搜查，但未发现空弹壳。

虽然枪击发生时校内及周边有许多学生，但未能找到证人。

    P.C.s 5C & 134 stated that at about 1 p.m. 1/5/40
whilst they were on duty on B'Well Road near Gordon Road
they heard reports which they took to be pistol shots and
when they were going to investigate the cause saw a male
Chinese running east on B'Well Road with a revolver in his
hand, they gave chase followed the man north along Majestic
Road and succeeding in arresting the accused on Majestic
Road near MacBain Road, An examination of the revolver
showed that 3 chambers had been fired whilst 2 chambers
still contained live rounds, revolver has been forwarded
to the A.I.C. for examination.
    The deceased's father Woo Vung Kya (胡文楷) was
located at No.9 Lane 406 Shanhaikwan Road, and brought to
the station and questioned but stated that he has not seen
his son since the end of January this year and does not
know where he was residing however he had called at his
home to see his father about 2 weeks ago but the latter
was absent.
    The deceased was searched and various documents were
found on his person these were handed over to D.I. Crighton
of C. 1 for examination.
    D.S. McKeown of the Special Branch also attended the
station and took particulars regarding the crime.

    警员5C号和134号（注：前文为58号）陈述，1940年5月1日下午1点左右，当他们在戈登路附近的静安寺路执勤时，听到他们认为可能是手枪射击的声音。当他们前去调查原因时，看见一名中国男子手持左轮手枪在静安寺路上向东奔跑。他们展开追捕，沿麦特赫司脱路（Majestic Road，即今泰兴路）向北跟随该男子，并在麦特赫司脱路靠近麦克贝恩路（MacBain Road，音译）处成功逮捕了被告。对左轮手枪的检查显示，3个弹膛已发射，另有2个弹膛仍装有实弹。左轮手枪已送交助理督察主任（A.I.C.）进行检验。
    死者的父亲胡文楷（Woo Vung Kya，音译）在山海关路406弄9号被找到，并被带到警局接受讯问，但他表示自今年一月底以来未见过儿子，也不知道其居住地。不过，死者约两周前曾回家看望父亲，但当时父亲不在家。
    对死者进行了搜身，在其身上发现了各种文件，这些文件已移交给C区1组的克莱顿（Crighton）督察进行检验。
    特别处的麦基翁（McKeown）副督察也来到警局，记录了有关此案的详细情况。
